Human beginnings.
settings.intro: Performance, ingredients, packaging and price. A daily essential, considered.
settings.image_alt: Hand holding a BPM metal tube

settings.heading:
It started
in a kitchen.
settings.body:
I started making deodorants in my kitchen in 2020 because I could not find one that met the full standard I had in mind. It needed to perform well, use natural ingredients, come in better packaging, feel good on skin, and still be priced fairly.

I did not come to BPM from a chemistry background. My background is in technology and product development, and that shaped the way I built this brand: by being thoughtful about every requirement, clear about priorities, and careful with the details.

I believed there was room for something better, and that natural products should be accessible to more people. BPM grew from that belief.

Corey Goss
Founder and President

settings.heading: Performance comes first.
settings.body: It fights odour, goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly. Product development starts with what the product needs to do.

settings.heading: Potion matters.
settings.body: Every ingredient is natural or naturally derived. If it doesn’t improve performance or skin feel, it doesn’t stay.

settings.heading: Packaging, responsibly chosen.
settings.body: Eco-friendly inks. Kraft paper boxes. Thoughtful material choices that balance sustainability with real-world performance.

settings.heading: Price with purpose.
settings.body: Fair. Transparent. No inflated margins hiding behind “natural.” As BPM grows, the aim is to lower prices.
